title: psychotria monticola var. fulva

It is a shrub native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. The bioactive constituents of Psychotria monticola var. fulva include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
